cards.title: Shared sessions
intro: When two classes run in the same room at the same time, Zooza treats their sessions as one shared session so the room is never double-booked. Add the classes that share a room to a shared-sessions set.
No shared-sessions sets have been created yet.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A name for this set, used only to identify it in this list.

fields.label: Active
fields.help: When switched off, the classes in this set no longer share a room and their sessions are no longer combined.

cards.title: Add › Match conditions
intro: Sessions are only combined when they run in the same room, on the same date, at overlapping times. This always applies and cannot be switched off.

fields.label: Also require the same instructor
fields.help: Compared against the originally assigned instructor, so arranging a substitute does not break the sharing.
